Day 1 · early morning

Put a real mind in them

Simville runs on templates by default. Load a language model and it takes over the dialogue, the end-of-day reflections, what people do with a free hour, and any question you ask them. The model runs entirely in this tab, on your GPU, through WebLLM and WebGPU. No server sees a word of it.

First load downloads the weights from Hugging Face and caches them in your browser — a few hundred megabytes to a couple of gigabytes, once. Needs WebGPU: Chrome or Edge 113+, Safari 26+.
